description_en: After you create an application session and start the application process, the session information is returned through a message
description_zh: 创建应用会话并启动应用进程后，会话信息通过消息返回
kebab_example: aliyun cgcs create-app-session-sync --app-id 130270000 --app-version 350670000 --custom-user-id 2YEF00000 --custom-session-id 1ADE00000 --client-ip 192.168.XX.XX --start-parameters Value=exampleValue Key=startArgument --system-info Value=OE0usD+AP0000 Key=utdid --tags Value=exampleValue Key=exampleTag --project-id d9a80000 --district-id huadong --match-rules '[{"Type":"in","Values":["exampleTag"],"Key":"component"}]' --adapter-file-id 501716211209548966XXXX --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAppSessionSync

parameters.help_en:
Custom User ID. Used for reading from and saving to archives. The maximum length is 64 characters.

element_fields.help_en:
Rule Type. Valid values:
in: Matches resources that carry the specified Key and Value.
notIn: Matches resources that do not carry the specified Key and Value
element_fields.help_zh:
规则类型。取值：
in：匹配携带指定 Key 和 Value 的资源。
notIn： 匹配不携带指定 Key 和 Value 的资源
element_fields.name: type

element_fields.help_en:
Tag Name provided by the resource.

Valid value: component, which refers to the widget Version. When a specific widget Version is specified, sessions are started only with resources that carry the specified widget Version
element_fields.help_zh:
资源提供的标签名称。

取值：component，组件版本；指定组件版本时，只会用带有指定组件版本的资源启动会话
